messages:
sam: CI red on main after the poetry.lock regen — multiple jobs failing with bcrypt wheel build errors. CircleCI job: https://ci.redwood.example/4321
ci-bot: [ci] Job failed: linux-musl-py311-wheel (job 4321) — exit 1
sam: quick log snippet:
```
  Building wheel for bcrypt (pyproject.toml) ... error
  ERROR: Failed building wheel for bcrypt
  subprocess-exited-with-error
  × Building wheel for bcrypt failed with exit code 1
  │ stderr: error: can't find Rust compiler `rustc`
```
darren: which PR changed the lockfile?
sam: looks like #3124 (by @jen) — it included a lock regen after some deps bumped
maya: I can repro locally on an alpine-based runner, same `rustc` missing error
maya: commands I used:
```bash
docker run --rm -it python:3.11-alpine sh -c "pip wheel bcrypt==4.1.0"
```
maya: it fails because bcrypt 4.1.0 now builds a Rust extension (cargo/rust required)
liz: fwiw our builder images don't include rust toolchain; we historically relied on prebuilt wheels for bcrypt
jen: digging — passlib got bumped in the regen (1.7.8 -> 1.8.0) and that pulls bcrypt 4.1.0 as a transitive update
darren: ok, two immediate options: pin bcrypt to 4.0.1 in constraints or add rustc to builder images (heavy). revert/ pin is faster
sam: agree pin/revert first, then decide long-term infra change if we want to support building from source
jen: I'll open a quick PR to pin bcrypt==4.0.1 in constraints and update poetry.lock to match — drafting now
maya: also note: some of our linux-musl runners run in smaller images (alpine) where manylinux wheels aren't available; so we either ensure wheels exist or add toolchain
darren: before a revert, can someone confirm passlib -> bcrypt is actually the transitive path?
maya: ran `poetry show --tree | grep -i bcrypt -B2 -A2` — shows passlib -> bcrypt 4.1.0
jen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4328 — pins bcrypt==4.0.1 and updates lockfile. requesting @darren @sam for quick review :eyes:
darren: reviewing now, looks straightforward
ci-bot: [ci] Triggered rebuild for PR/4328 by jen — jobs queued
jen: merged the pin PR, rolling back lock changes that pulled 4.1.0
sam: re-running the failing CI job now
ci-bot: [ci] Job retriggered by sam — job 4321 rerun
ci-bot: [ci] Job succeeded: linux-musl-py311-wheel (job 4321) — all checks passed
sam: CI green on re-run, thanks all :tada:
maya: created follow-up issue to track infra decision on builder images / rust toolchain: #789
liz: put it in eng-infra backlog, we should decide if adding rust is acceptable for build image size
darren: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. we should add a note in the lockfile PR checklist to call out transitive native/rust builds
jen: added checklist item to PR template
sam: great — closing the loop here. if anyone sees other transitive native bumps, ping eng-infra. :thumbsup:
